abilities.name: Deny Ground
abilities.text: Roll 2d10, unopposed. Choose a point within 5 units. Create Difficult Terrain in a Sphere with hex radius 1 (7 hexes) until the start of your next Turn. Creatures entering the area for the first time each Turn lose 1 additional Movement.

abilities.name: Bind Position
abilities.text: Once between Recoveries. Range 4; vs. Fortitude or Harmony, chosen when the enemy is built. On success, the target becomes Immobilized until the end of its next Turn. Surge 2: also make the target Exposed for the same duration.

system.gmNotes:
Role use. Change paths and timing rather than dealing much Damage. A Controller becomes more dangerous when a Striker or Blaster can exploit the spaces it denies.

Starting Enemy Example (Essence v0.6, Part XIV). Playtest reference; change its fictional presentation freely.
